Left edge shows the neighbouring page's margin notes, which are cut off and not legible enough to transcribe; they are not transcribed.

main_text.p: Apostolicos, fieri perplurimos phanaticos homines, suos enthusiasmos & reuelationes iactantes.
main_text.head: COLL.
Ioannis Alberti, ducis Megapolensis, sedulitas in promouendis iuuenum studijs, & audiendo uerbo diuino.
main_text.p: In Italia mos est, ut principes audiant & inspiciant studia, sicut etiam inter principes Germaniæ olim fuit consuetudo. Vix ullum autem hanc consuetudinem imitari uideo, nisi Iohannem Albertū principem Megapolensem, qui quotannis aliqua examina in schola Suerinensi instituit, quibus illustrissimus Princeps ipse interest, & simul pueros examinat: bene quoq; respondentibus munera non exigua largitur. Alias etiam extra examina idem Princeps scholas accedit, & studia ac mores iuuenum considerat. Præterea tanta assiduitate concionies Dominicales & alias annotat, ut post multos annos concionatoribus locos, quos eo tempore tra ctauerint, indicare possit, ac citò negligentiam eorum in studijs deprehendat.
main_text.head: COLL.
Mauricij ducis & Electoris Saxoniæ memorabile factum.
main_text.p: Laudādus inter cæteros mihi occurrit Dux et Electoris

page.notes: Left margin notes are cut off by the gutter and the scan edge; not transcribed. Last line is partly obscured at the foot; "Ele-ctor" reads as "Elector" continued on the next page. Catchword "Laudādus" is taken from the line ending the page; the signature reads "iii 2" as printed beside the foot.
